M1.name: FiLM FNO transfer
M1.adaptation: Coordinate input and parameter FiLM at every FNO block, with LF to HF transfer. Tests repeated conditioning and spectral transfer.

M2.name: All pairs FNO
M2.adaptation: Fidelity labels and repeated target supervision. Poseidon is pair enumeration inspiration only. No source field input.

M3.name: ConvNeXt transfer
M3.adaptation: ConvNeXt blocks in a U shaped field decoder, parameter FiLM, and LF to HF transfer. Tests local spatial processing.

M4.name: Distribution FNO
M4.adaptation: FIRE distribution summaries become spatial channels from five LF FNOs. A trained residual FNO replaces foundation model inference.

M5.name: Wavelet transfer
M5.adaptation: WNO motivates a custom single level db4 coefficient mixer with FiLM and transfer training.

M6.name: Retrieved field DeepONet
M6.adaptation: Parameters and a nearest neighbour LF training field enter the branch. The residual needs no new coarse solve.

M7.name: POD GP
M7.adaptation: HF field SVD and shared coefficient GP hyperparameters. Basis emulation inspiration, not the original Bayesian model.

M8.name: Slice attention corrector
M8.adaptation: Changed pooling and cell to slice attention, parameter FiLM, and six corrections of a predicted coarse field.

M9.name: ConvNeXt corrector
M9.adaptation: ConvNeXt blocks in a U shaped corrector with FiLM. Six updates refine a predicted coarse field rather than generating it directly.

B1.name: Autoregressive POD GP
B1.adaptation: KOH inspired scalar field coupling plus a separate residual POD GP. Not joint probabilistic co kriging.

B2.name: Nonlinear POD GP
B2.adaptation: NARGP inspired coefficient kernel with shared covariance hyperparameters and Monte Carlo LF uncertainty.

B3.name: Composite MF MLP
B3.adaptation: Meng inspired pointwise LF network and staged linear plus nonlinear HF corrections.

B4.name: Composite MF DeepONet
B4.adaptation: Howard inspired LF sensor prediction and staged linear plus nonlinear DeepONets.

B5.name: Latent MF network
B5.adaptation: DMFAL inspires two latent levels. Deterministic MSE replaces the probabilistic objective and acquisition.

B6.name: Nonlinear decoder transfer
B6.adaptation: NOMAD motivates a custom nonlinear coordinate decoder. Multifidelity behavior comes from transfer training.

B7.name: MFRNP adapter
B7.adaptation: Upstream MFRNP model with data, normalization, resize, batching, context, and training adaptations.

B8.name: Fidelity basis FNO
B8.adaptation: IFC inspires fidelity dependence. Spatial basis FNO omits the original neural ODE and GP.

B9.name: FNO transfer I
B9.adaptation: Parameters concatenated with coordinates and LF to HF transfer. Same inspected recipe as B10.

B10.name: FNO transfer II
B10.adaptation: Separately archived transfer run with the same inspected model and training code as B9.

B11.name: Affine POD GP
B11.adaptation: One affine slope and intercept across fields applied to an LF POD GP. Conceptual inspiration only.
